description: Kalibrierung von Trübungsmessungen am Eider-Sperrwerk im März 2024 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. The eider has been subject to increased sediment input for several decades. This affects the drainage of the hinterland as well as the navigability of the federal waterway. In addition, there is the influence of long-term changes caused by climate change, which leads to additional challenges in the drainage of the hinterland. Coverage: Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. The portal shows the English title as "Calibration of turbidity measurements at the Eider barrier in March 2024" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. Its keywords include 2024, Eider, Eider-Sperrwerk, ENVI, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
